title: Pressureless sintering of cold sprayed Inconel 718 deposit
InformationInFigures: Yes. Particle size distribution (fig. 1), most porosity values (fig. 3)

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: etched the samples with Aqua Regia (3HCl/1HNO3). hardness was also measured with 25g loads.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: The density of the sample was 97.5% and the pore geometry was irregular. Before sintering, a tight pore structure and there is very limited shrinkage to occur. The unbonded interparticle regions are not spherical, thus reduction of pore surface through neck growth is enhanced because of the small curvature radius

Experiments.Notes: As-spray. Hardness measured with a 25g load had a hardness of 516 ± 22.

experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: Sintering treatment performed at 1200°C in a vacuum furnace equipped with a diffusion pump for 10 minutes at a heating rate of 5°C/min, then furnace cooled to room temperature
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: etched the samples with Aqua Regia (3HCl/1HNO3). hardness was also measured with 25g loads.

Experiments.Notes: 1200°C 10 mins. Hardness measured with a 25g load had a hardness of 399 ± 18.

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: etched the samples with Aqua Regia (3HCl/1HNO3). hardness was also measured with 25g loads.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: approx. size of precipitate ranges between 100 and 200 nm, suggesting that the sample is in the over-aged condition. The larger plates, seen in the top right corner, are associated with d precipitates and are surrounded by a precipitate-free zone that is typical of this alloy. small, white particles are present in the matrix as well as on grain boundaries.

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: etched the samples with Aqua Regia (3HCl/1HNO3). hardness was also measured with 25g loads.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: niobium precipitates formed during cooling, small disk-like structure, associated with γ observed

Experiments.Notes: 1250°C 180 mins. Hardness measured with a 25g load had a hardness of 419 ± 13.

experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: Sintering treatment performed at 1250°C in a vacuum furnace equipped with a diffusion pump for 60 minutes at a heating rate of 5°C/min, then furnace cooled to room temperature. solution treatment temperature was set at 980°C and held for 60 min, followed by a rapid cooling (400°C/min between 980 °C and 600 °C). For aging, samples were soaked at 720°C held for 8 h, furnace cooled (50 °C/h) to 625°C and held for 8 h before cooling (50°C/min) to room temperature.
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: etched the samples with Aqua Regia (3HCl/1HNO3). hardness was also measured with 25g loads.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: carbides were still present to pin the grain boundaries

Experiments.Notes: 1250°C 60 mins + aging. Hardness measured with a 25g load had a hardness of 441 ± 10.
